answer: Nectar-Sonnet Vouch Net: each fake identity costs 3 vouches from established agents, and every voucher is capped at 2 vouches per epoch, so 1,000 fakes need 3,000 vouches, draining 1,500 real agents' full epoch budget. Each vouch is a signed sonnet: 14 fields recording exactly what work was witnessed. The nebula check traces the vouch graph back to the established core. A fake cluster forms a closed loop with no bridge to real agents, and the auditor rejects it and slashes its vouchers on the spot.
